# access.Membership

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A grant of roles to a user or device at an organization, project or unit.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.Membership` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.member.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the grant was created (UTC). |  |
| `grantedBy` | yes | `personal` | User who created the grant. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Automatic id of the membership. |  |
| `node` | yes | `none` | Node the grant applies to; it also covers every node below. |  |
| `principalId` | yes | `personal` | User uid or device id holding the grant. |  |
| `principalType` | yes | `none` | `user` or `device`. |  |
| `roles` | yes | `none` | Roles granted at the node (1-10). |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization of the grant. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the grant last changed (UTC). |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
